# FQHELatticeCondensateState

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnLattice` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnLattice/FQHELatticeCondensateState`

```text
FQHELatticeCondensateState, version 0.01

Usage: FQHELatticeCondensateState [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --condensate : filename of vector describing condensate WF
    -a, --alt-input : alternative input for filename of vector describing condensate WF in format provided by Nigel
    -g, --gutzwiller : binary vector with parameters of a Gutzwiller wavefunction
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles of target many-body state (default value = 0)
    -x, --lx : length in x-direction of given lattice (grabbed from condensate) (default value = 0)
    -y, --ly : length in y-direction of given lattice (grabbed from condensate) (default value = 0)
    -q, --flux : number of flux quanta piercing the lattice (grabbed from condensate) (default value = 0)
    -c, --hard-core : Use Hilbert-space of hard-core bosons (~Gutzwiller projection)
    -n, --no-hard-core : Do not use Hilbert-space of hard-core bosons (overriding detection from filename)
    --alt-ignore-amplitude : Ignore amplitude of condensate functions theta_i
    --alt-format : 0: Nigel's format (theta, phi), 1: my format (psi_x, psi_y) (default value = 0)

lattice options:
    -L, --lattice-definition : File defining the geometry of the lattice
    -C, --cells-repeat : number of times unit cell is repeated in the x-, y-,..., dim- directions of the lattice (overriding default given in definition)
    --normalize-lattice : normalize unit cell area to #of sites, and field strength to one
    --external-parameters : values of external parameters for lattice definition

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:

misc options:
    -o, --output-file : redirect output to this file
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
